description: Where liquidations WOULD happen for one coin: the liquidation heatmap over time built from real tracked Hyperliquid positions. Returns the largest clusters of liquidatable positions above the mark (shorts) and below it (longs) in the newest snapshot, with USD at risk and the distance from the mark. Use it for "where are the liquidation levels / magnets for BTC?". For liquidations that already happened use get_liquidations.

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

end.description: End of the window (default now). Set it to look at the heatmap of an earlier time.

hours.description: Look-back window in hours (default 24; capped by the plan's heatmap history: no key 24 h, a free key 30 days; the answer says when it was cut).

tf.description: Column interval (default: chosen from hours: 15m up to 7 days, 1h up to 30 days, then 4h, 12h and 1d). Every key opens 5m to 1d within its plan history; without a key 5m, 15m and 1h over 24 hours; 1m needs Desk or API Pro (plan_required).

name: get_liquidation_heatmap

clustersAbove.description: Largest clusters above the mark: price, usd, longUsd, shortUsd, distance.

error.description: Only on a failed call (isError: true): code, message and, from the API, status, param, doc_url, request_id.

hours.description: Window served in hours (after the plan clamp).

meta.description: The API meta block: updatedAt, source (venues), sources, plan, delayMinutes, license, attribution (the credit line to show), access, warnings, restricted.

newest.description: longUsd / shortUsd liquidatable in the newest snapshot.

title: Liquidation heatmap
